title: Italian pasta salad

items: 1 Tbsp kosher salt (for the pasta water)
½ cup sliced black olives, drained
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 red bell pepper, cut into ½-inch dice
¼ cup torn fresh basil leaves

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the 1 Tbsp salt. Cook the rotini for the full package time, until tender. Cold pasta firms up, so don't undercook it.
Drain and rinse under cold water, tossing, until cool. Shake the colander well; leftover water dilutes the dressing.
If making the homemade dressing, shake the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper in a jar until blended.
In a large bowl, combine the pasta, mozzarella, tomatoes, olives, chickpeas and bell pepper. Pour ½ cup of the dressing over and toss well.
Cover and chill at least 30 min so the flavors blend.
Right before serving, toss in the basil and the remaining ¼ cup dressing, since the pasta soaks up the first round. Taste and add salt if needed.
tips: Add the basil at the end. It turns black if it sits in dressing overnight.
Add 4 oz diced salami for a meat version.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days in a sealed container. Don't leave it out more than 2 hr. Stir in a splash of dressing or olive oil before serving leftovers. Don't freeze.
